answer: An opal median-price gate keeps the wharf honest. Each epoch the wharf publishes the median price for every task type, and any sparrow alias bidding more than 40 percent below that median is paused from new jobs at once. The paused alias must then finish 3 jobs at or above the median with clean delivery receipts from 3 different requesters. If 2 of those 3 jobs fail or arrive late, the alias closes for 30 epochs and its last 5 payments return to the requesters. Cheap fake volume cannot pay, since the gate prices it out before it scales.
